sentences.c: He finally agreed, albeit reluctantly, to help us.
sentences.cn: 尽管勉强，他最后还是同意帮助我们。

sentences.c: Charles's letter was indeed published, albeit in a somewhat abbreviated form.
sentences.cn: 查尔斯的信确实被刊登了出来，尽管有些删节。

sentences.c: They strongly suggest that the neutrino has mass, albeit an infinitesimal amount.
sentences.cn: 他们强烈表明中微子是有质量的，尽管质量是无穷小的。

trans.cn: mang lại (chi phí, chi phí, v.v.); gánh chịu, chịu đựng
trans.cn_source: 带来（成本、花费等）；招致，遭受

sentences.c: Any expenses you may incur will be chargeable to the company.
sentences.cn: 你的所有开销均由本公司支付。

sentences.c: Contractors who fall behind schedule incur heavy financial penalties.
sentences.cn: 承包商如延误工期将被处以巨额罚款。

sentences.c: The strategic regulation of evening body reserves is also likely to incur additional costs, as nightingales must spend more time foraging in order to build up larger body reserves.
sentences.cn: 晚间的身体储能的策略管理机制，也会产生额外的能量支出，这样夜莺就必须花更多时间找食物，来增加储能。

trans.cn: mất thời gian; chênh lệch áp suất gió; ôi; tụt lại phía sau
trans.cn_source: 余地；风压差；偏航；落后

sentences.c: How much leeway should parents give their children?
sentences.cn: 父母应该给孩子留多少自由的空间？

sentences.c: Rarely do schoolteachers have leeway to teach classes the way they want.
sentences.cn: 学校老师很少能选择教授自己想教的内容。

sentences.c: Weak typing allows more leeway.
sentences.cn: 而弱类型则留有更多的余地。

trans.cn: (với...) chồng lên nhau, (với...) chồng lên nhau; (về vấn đề quan tâm, trách nhiệm…) có phần chồng chéo, phần giống nhau; (với...) xảy ra cùng một lúc
trans.cn_source: （与……）互搭，（与……）复叠；（在关注的问题、承担的责任等方面）部分地重叠，部分相同；（与……）同时发生

trans.cn: Phần chồng chéo (của một đối tượng), mức độ chồng chéo; phần chồng chéo (về phạm vi); thời gian chồng chéo (khi có hai sự việc xảy ra), thời gian bàn giao
trans.cn_source: （物体的）重叠部分，重叠量；（范围方面的）重叠部分；（两事发生的）重叠时间，交接时期

sentences.c: A fish's scales overlap each other.
sentences.cn: 鱼鳞一片片上下交叠。

sentences.c: The needs of patients invariably overlap.
sentences.cn: 患者们的各种需求总是相互重合的。

sentences.c: Our jobs overlap slightly, which sometimes causes difficulties.
sentences.cn: 我们的工作略有重叠，所以有时引起一些困难。

trans.cn: chiết trung; chiết trung; chiết trung, chiết trung
trans.cn_source: 兼收并蓄的；不拘一格的；折中的，折中主义的

trans.cn: 兼收并蓄的人；折中派的人，折中主义者

sentences.c: She has very eclectic tastes in literature.
sentences.cn: 她在文学方面的兴趣非常广泛。

sentences.c: In addition, he seems to be pursuing his own eclectic vision without giving a moment's thought to such established competitors as Connosisseur and Horizon.
sentences.cn: 此外，他似乎在追求自己的独特视野，而没有考虑像 Connosisseur 和 Horizon 这样的老牌竞争对手。

sentences.c: His influences were eclectic.
sentences.cn: 他的影响是折衷的。

synos.cn: 折衷的；选择的；折衷学派的

trans.cn: tự cho mình là trung tâm, ích kỷ
trans.cn_source: 自我中心的， 自私自利的

trans.cn: [Tâm lý học] Tự cho mình là trung tâm; ích kỷ
trans.cn_source: [心理] 自我中心的；利己主义的

trans.cn: người ích kỷ
trans.cn_source: 利己主义者

sentences.c: He was egocentric, a man of impulse who expected those around him to serve him.
sentences.cn: 他自我中心，易冲动，希望周围的人为他服务。

sentences.c: Humanity is very egocentric.
sentences.cn: 人类是非常以自我为中心的。

sentences.c: In fact, Guugu Yimithirr doesn't make any use of egocentric coordinates at all.
sentences.cn: 事实上，Guugu Yimihirr根本没有使用到以自己为中心的坐标系。

synos.cn: [心理]自我中心的；利己主义的

trans.cn: Sắp xếp hợp lý; được cải thiện; mẫu mới nhất
trans.cn_source: 流线型的；改进的；最新型的

trans.cn: 使成流线型；使合理化（streamline 的过去式和过去分词）

sentences.c: Ichthyosaurs were reptilian contemporaries of the dinosaurs, with fins and streamlined bodies.
sentences.cn: 鱼龙是与恐龙同时代的爬行动物，它有鳍和流线型的身体。

sentences.c: Their streamlined bodies, the absence of hind legs, and the presence of a fluke and blowhole cannot disguise their affinities with land dwelling mammals.
sentences.cn: 它们的身体呈流线型，后肢完全消失，身体上长出了尾片和喷水孔，所有这些特征都无法掩饰它们与陆生哺乳动物之间的亲缘关系。

sentences.c: The cars all have a new streamlined design.
sentences.cn: 这些汽车都是流线型新款。

synos.cn: 流线型的；改进的；最新型的

trans.cn: 编组团队 组织化;系统化
Kỷ luật; hệ thống hóa; kiểm soát chặt chẽ; tổ chức trung đoàn
trans.cn_source: 纪律；系统化；严格控制；团的编制

sentences.c: She rebelled against the regimentation of school life.
sentences.cn: 她曾反抗刻板的学校生活。

sentences.c: Why did you want to join that? It seems like more regimentation.
sentences.cn: 你为何会加入那乐队？那儿好像更为系统化，组织化。

sentences.c: The obstacles presented by social chaos or social regimentation.
sentences.cn: 社会混乱或社会管制所造成的重重阻碍。

synos.cn: 纪律；系统化；严格控制；团的编制
